Multi-site practice: CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills, an independent official profile at Continental Hospitals Hyderabad, and a stated attachment to 'Radhika's Heart Clinic for Kids', Somajiguda, Hyderabad. Elite international training and foreign board credentials, publicly described as 'the only American trained Pediatric Cardiologist in the Telugu states', with a 3-year Pediatric Cardiology fellowship at Wayne State University's Children's Hospital of Michigan, Detroit; post-graduate training at Kaiser Permanente Oakland, Cook County Children's Hospital Chicago, Vanderbilt University Medical Center and Children's Hospital of Philadelphia; MBBS Gandhi Medical College / Osmania University 1991. Post-nominals published as MD, FAAP, FACC, FASE (Fellow of the American College of Cardiology, American Academy of Pediatrics, American Society of Echocardiography). Authors clinical content for CARE Hospitals' 'Doctor Speak' series. No publicly stated procedure volume was found, so none is recorded.
